column3: Run the Dine tests and start the app
column5: In apps/dine run npm install then npm test. Start with MONGODB_URI and DINE_SESSION_SECRET (port 5009); open GET /api/health; remove the settings and try an /api route. Follow docs/products/dine/DEV_A_STEPS.md.
column6: Tests pass (9 files); health ok true; without settings every /api route answers 503
column7: A test fails or the app runs without settings
column11: Plain-node checks that already pass: 80 (rules 23, allinone 13, summary 4, routes 16, signup 4, session 3, app 2, tenantWiring 4, discount 11). Route tests use spy models, not a real database; the real-database file is DIN-QA

column3: Walk one table end to end with a real database
column5: Sign up (header x-requested-with: afra-dine). Add menu items, open an order, add lines, send to kitchen, serve, bill, pay. Pay the same order twice. Have two phones add a line at the same moment.
column6: Second payment refused; the second phone is told Someone else just changed this order
column7: Double payment accepted, or one phone silently overwrites the other

column3: Two venues never see each other
column5: Two venues, two logins: venue B tries venue As orders, menu, cash, customers by id, and with tenantId in body and query.
column6: Nothing of A is visible to B

column3: Recipe stock goes down once and day close
column5: Create a recipe, sell the dish and check the ingredient fell by the recipe amount once. Close the day with a counted amount below expected. Open the CA export in a spreadsheet.
column6: Ingredient down once; status short; a bill number starting with = shows as text
column7: Ingredient falls twice, or a formula runs

column5: Sign in as kitchen, captain, bartender and cashier. Try billing, discount, void, reopen, settings, accounts, export, menu price change.
column6: Each role can do only what its permission allows; refused routes change nothing
column7: A role reaches a route it should not
column11: Kitchen, captain and bartender have no discount permission

column5: As cashier discount 10 percent with a reason (works) then 11 percent (refused with the limit). Owner sets owner_only: cashier refused. No reason: refused. Reopen the bill and check the discount is cleared.
column6: Over-limit and no-reason refused with 403 or 400, nothing saved; reopen clears the discount

column3: Other venue ids, replay and tampering
column5: Use venue As order, table, menu and recipe ids from venue B. Replay a payment request. Send a line with a changed price or a negative quantity.
column6: Not found; second payment refused; prices come from the menu on the server
column7: A change reaches venue A or a price is accepted from the client

column6: Items show with the right prices

column3: Take an order and split the bill
column5: Open table 3, add 4 lines, send to the kitchen and bar, serve, then split the bill equally between 2 people and by items.
column6: Kitchen and bar tickets separate; the split parts add up to the whole bill in whole rupees
column7: Split parts do not add up, or tickets mixed

column6: 5 percent works; 30 percent is refused with the limit

column5: Void one line before billing and reopen a billed order.
column6: Voids need a reason and show to the owner; reopen clears the discount and payment state

column7: Variance wrong or happy price outside hours
